authority_contract.composition_boundary: Pool Swap core v1, Pool Swap fee-growth v1, Pool runtime v1, segment-field v2, and direct schema are semantic inputs; Mint v2 and the other complete matrices are ordering-only
authority_contract.constructor_fallthrough_boundary: constructor receiver evidence covers only an internal map-set immediately followed by a direct terminal local.get with equal time-scoped receiver origins; it does not prove that all successful constructor returns or control paths return that receiver
authority_contract.derived_boundary: all thirteen derived fields lack a direct Graph store transition; five have static child-association setter paths, but query visibility remains unproved
authority_contract.duplicate_save_boundary: the modern duplicate save is retained lexical call order and shared receiver-operand local-name evidence only; common execution and receiver must-alias remain false, and Graph visibility, persistence, version, and last-writer semantics remain false
authority_contract.host_boundary: numeric, comparator, contract-call, alias, Graph store, persistence, visibility, rollback, post-fatal, historical, and last-writer semantics are not rederived
authority_contract.legacy_post_store_boundary: five legacy-mainnet profiles have twelve handler setters after their helper's only earlier origin-overlap store and no lexically later handler overlap store; the same field identities remain classified only because another setter invocation has a lexically later same-group overlap store
authority_contract.lexical_origin_overlap_boundary: a classified stored field needs an exact setter flow plus at least one lexically later same-group store whose branch-merged receiver origin set overlaps the setter origin set. This may-alias relation does not establish a jointly feasible continuation, branch correlation, or receiver must-alias, and the ledger is not one execution trace
authority_contract.no_setter_boundary: 45 stored fields per segment have a reachable entity store but no reachable schema-API setter path; none is described as preserved, unchanged, or value-exact
authority_contract.physical_vs_semantic_ledger_boundary: 1,404 reachable functions, 9,968 direct calls, 2,368 direct writes, 754 physical TypedMap#set sites, 1,608 nullable-expanded site-to-invocation edges, 1,576 lexical field invocations, and 2,072 expanded setter paths are separate fail-closed denominators
authority_contract.receiver_flow_and_origin_overlap_boundar: all 1,576 lexical setters bind their exact retained-WAT receiver operand through any named setter parameter, or through a constructor's internal map-set receiver to its immediately following terminal get on normal fallthrough, to 1,608 physical receiver-flow edges; all 163 lexical stores separately bind exact target, receiver, and stored-value operands. Cross-ledger classification is limited to same-group finite-CFG, loop-fixed-point receiver-origin overlap. The worklist models if/else/block/loop, every br/br_if/br_table target, loop backedges, and return/unreachable termination. At invocation level, 1,089 classifications have only equal-origin-set store references and 487 have overlap-only references. Separately, 1,720 setter-to-store edges comprise 1,233 exact-equal and 487 overlap-only edges. The 60 legacy helper-return invocation classifications reference 15 materialized stable-ID helper records scoped to the internal store's immediate normal fallthrough into the terminal return get
authority_contract.returned_helper_fallthrough_boundary: each materialized helper record requires the same receiver local, equal receiver origins, and immediate internal-store/terminal-get adjacency on normal fallthrough; it does not prove that all helper invocations or control paths return the stored receiver
authority_contract.schema_authority: direct schema.graphql plus the independently recomputed 299-field segment-field v2 catalog
authority_contract.semantic_authority: exact retained deployed Pool mapping WASM regenerated through the independently recomputed Swap core and fee-growth v1 certificates
authority_contract.store_profile_boundary: five legacy-mainnet mappings have 19 lexical and 25 expanded stores; legacy Base has 22 and 28; both modern mappings have 23 and 29, including two ordered PoolHourData saves with the same receiver operand local name and no intervening PoolHourData setter
authority_contract.swap_nullability_boundary: direct schema authority has fourteen required Swap fields and nullable logIndex; all fifteen have setter paths and the required-absence overlay is zero
